name: Christmas & Holidays
tagline: Cozy sweaters, twinkling trees and holiday-card magic.
description: Everything for your holiday card and December posts: the decorated tree, fireside cocoa, a snowy porch with a wreath, Christmas markets, festive sweaters, gift wrapping, cookie baking, candlelit dinners and ice skating under the lights. Warm, twinkly and genuinely cozy.
